NVARCHAR.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
NVARCHAR.examples.basic.sql: DECLARE @title nvarchar(200)   -- Default 1 when length omitted, MAX can hold 2 GB

VARCHAR.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
VARCHAR.examples.basic.sql: DECLARE @code varchar(20)   -- Characters limited by collation; use NVARCHAR

DECIMAL.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
DECIMAL.examples.basic.sql: DECLARE @amount decimal(18, 2)   -- 18 total digits, 2 decimal places

DATETIME2.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
DATETIME2.examples.basic.sql: DECLARE @at datetime2(3)   -- Parentheses are fractional second precision, default 7

BIT.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
BIT.examples.basic.sql: DECLARE @isActive bit = 1   -- Strings 'TRUE'/'FALSE' can also be converted

UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.examples.basic.sql: DECLARE @id uniqueidentifier = NEWID()   -- Clustered key causes splits

NOLOCK.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
NOLOCK.examples.basic.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Loan WITH (NOLOCK)   -- Row may appear/disappear

READPAST.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
READPAST.examples.basic.sql: SELECT TOP (1) CopyNo FROM dbo.Copy WITH (READPAST, UPDLOCK)   -- Get one unlocked row

UPDLOCK.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
UPDLOCK.examples.basic.sql: SELECT CopyNo FROM dbo.Copy WITH (UPDLOCK) WHERE CopyNo = 1   -- Lock row before update

INDEX.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
INDEX.examples.basic.sql: SELECT * FROM dbo.Loan WITH (INDEX(IX_Loan_ReaderId))   -- Name or number

RECOMPILE.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
RECOMPILE.examples.basic.sql: SELECT * FROM dbo.Loan WHERE ReaderId = @readerId OPTION (RECOMPILE)   -- Plan not cached

MAXDOP.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
MAXDOP.examples.basic.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.LoanDetail OPTION (MAXDOP 1)   -- 0 uses config

@@ROWCOUNT.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
@@ROWCOUNT.examples.basic.sql: UPDATE dbo.Loan SET LoanDate = SYSDATETIME(); SELECT @@ROWCOUNT   -- Next overwrites

@@ERROR.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
@@ERROR.examples.basic.sql: IF @@ERROR <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION   -- Previous stmt only; use TRY

@@IDENTITY.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
@@IDENTITY.examples.basic.sql: INSERT dbo.Loan (ReaderId) VALUES (1); SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY()   -- Triggers mislead

@@TRANCOUNT.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
@@TRANCOUNT.examples.basic.sql: BEGIN TRANSACTION; SELECT @@TRANCOUNT   -- Nested only outer commits

@@FETCH_STATUS.examples.basic.title: Basic usage
@@FETCH_STATUS.examples.basic.sql: WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 FETCH NEXT FROM copies INTO @copyNo   -- 0 success
